# Request for Proposal — Cybersecurity Assessment and Penetration Testing Services

Reference: EDSA/RFP/2026/114
Issued by: Emirate Digital Services Authority, Dubai, United Arab Emirates
Issue date: 3 February 2026
Proposal deadline: 17 March 2026, 14:00 Gulf Standard Time

## 1. Scope of services

1.1 The supplier shall perform security testing of 25 web applications,
12 application programming interfaces and 3 mobile applications.

1.2 The engagement shall be completed within eight weeks of contract award.

## 2. Supplier qualification

2.1 The supplier must hold a current penetration-testing accreditation from a
recognised assurance scheme, and must provide the certificate.

2.2 The supplier must hold current ISO/IEC 27001 certification covering the
delivery of the proposed services, and must provide the certificate.

2.3 The supplier must propose at least two testers holding current Offensive
Security Certified Professional certification.

2.4 The supplier must provide three comparable projects delivered in the United
Arab Emirates or wider Gulf Cooperation Council region within the last three
years, with customer references for each.

## 3. Technical requirements

3.1 The supplier must describe its web application testing methodology.

3.2 The supplier must describe its application programming interface testing
methodology.

3.3 The supplier must describe its mobile application testing methodology,
including device coverage and the mobile security testing standard applied.

3.4 The supplier must submit a project schedule covering the eight-week
delivery period, showing testing, reporting and retesting phases.

3.5 The supplier must nominate a Project Manager for the engagement and provide
the curriculum vitae of the nominated individual.

3.6 The supplier must provide curricula vitae for all proposed testing
personnel, including certifications held.

## 4. Commercial requirements

4.1 The supplier must price the engagement using the supplied bill of
quantities and must state the daily rate applied for each proposed role.

4.2 Technical and commercial proposals must be submitted as separate documents.
Pricing must not appear anywhere in the technical proposal.

## 5. Submission

5.1 The proposal must be signed by a representative authorised to commit the
supplier's company.

5.2 The supplier must submit a completed and signed non-disclosure agreement
with the proposal.
